living.title: Cost of living in Padua | University of Padua
quotes: Cost of living in Padua These are some examples of general expenses that you need to cover to live in Padua as a Unipd student.
Accommodation in a single room: from € 300 to € 600 + expenses
Supermarket grocery shopping for one week: approximately € 60
Application for issue / renewal of the residence permit for study purposes: approximately € 116,46
Health insurance valid for the issue / renewal of the residence permit for study purposes: approximately from € 120 to € 150

program.name: Information Engineering
program.summary: Information Engineering, bachelor's degree, 3 years (180 ECTS), taught in English, University of Padua.

costs.note: EUR 2,950 a year (course page). Compulsory fees: the EUR 208 first-year instalment (regional tax EUR 192 + stamp duty EUR 16) from the fees page; the course page doesn't say whether the EUR 2,950 already includes it.

living.note: Our calculation from the University of Padua's cost-of-living page: single room up to EUR 600 a month × 12, groceries EUR 60 a week × 52, annual bus travelcard EUR 247.50, residence permit EUR 116.46 and health insurance up to EUR 150 = EUR 10,834 a year. Utilities and other expenses on top of rent aren't priced.

admissions.threshold: Information Engineering: no school-grade cut-off is published. Entry needs the CISIA CEnT-S test and places go by a ranking list (limited access).

english.min_score: English B2 level (CEFR) or equivalent; accepted certificates and exemptions on the University of Padua's list.
